description: Vehicles Entering U.S. by Country is a dataset listed in data.bts.gov (Bureau of Transportation Statistics open data), an open data portal of the Bureau of Transportation Statistics under the section "Roadways and Bridges", published or maintained by U.S. Customs and Border Patrol. Number of passenger vehicles crossing into the United States via Canada and Mexico, and number of freight trucks crossing into U.S. via Niagara Falls. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Roadways and Bridges". It has 8 columns, among them Lowest Date, Week Num, Current, Lowest, Baseline, Indicator. The portal shows 2026-06-15 as the last data update. Attribution given: U.S. Customs and Border Patrol. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is U.S. federal government work, public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-bts-data-bts-gov-portal.
